title: Art and Music
description: Colours, sounds, songs and making things.

entries.title: Colour
entries.summary: Colours can be mixed to make new colours.
entries.body: Red, yellow and blue are the main colours. Mixing two of them makes a new one: red and yellow make orange, blue and yellow make green. Light and paint behave a little differently when they mix.
facts: A rainbow is the spectrum of light split into colours.

entries.title: Drawing Shapes
entries.summary: Every picture is built from shapes.
entries.body: Artists draw with lines, squares, circles and triangles. Large simple shapes first, then smaller details on top, is a good way to build a picture. Looking carefully at the real thing helps you draw it well.
facts: Every picture can be broken down into simple shapes.
Drawing big shapes first makes the drawing easier.
Artists look carefully before they draw.

entries.title: Famous Artists
entries.summary: Some artists became very well known.
entries.body: Leonardo da Vinci painted the Mona Lisa and designed flying machines. Vincent van Gogh painted thick bright strokes of sunflowers. Frida Kahlo painted many pictures of herself and her family.
facts: Leonardo da Vinci was also an inventor and scientist.
Van Gogh painted more than 2,000 works in about ten years.
Frida Kahlo's pictures often show her in Mexican dress.

entries.title: Music
entries.summary: Music is made of sounds that follow a pattern.
entries.body: Music has a beat, a melody and a rhythm. Songs from long ago are still sung today, and different countries have their own instruments and tunes. Some people play by ear without reading music.
facts: Music has a beat, a melody and a rhythm.
Every culture has its own instruments and songs.
Playing an instrument needs practice and patience.

entries.title: Instruments
entries.summary: Instruments make sound in different ways.
entries.body: Strings, woodwind, brass and drums are the big families of instruments. A violin makes sound with strings, a flute with air, and a drum when you hit it. Many instruments are made from wood, metal or skin.
facts: A violin makes sound with vibrating strings.
A flute makes sound with air.
Instruments are usually made from wood, metal or skin.

entries.title: Beat and Rhythm
entries.summary: Music is made of patterns of sounds.
entries.body: Your heartbeat is a steady beat. Music is built from beats that are long and short - that is rhythm. Clapping along to a song helps you feel the beat and makes the music easier to remember.
facts: Clapping helps you feel the beat of a song.
A pattern of long and short sounds is a rhythm.
Your heartbeat is a steady beat.
